subject.title: Feature request: auto-update for skills and plugins

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in background updater for installed ClawHub skills and managed plugins, and which trust gates must be mandatory before it can run?
rationale: The implementation shape is inseparable from a supply-chain security boundary: automatic updates could replace executable skill/plugin code without an operator looking at each release.

options.title: Design gated auto-update
options.body: Proceed only after maintainers define signing or digest verification, moderation state, pin/deny behavior, rollback, failure reporting, and explicit opt-in semantics.

options.title: Keep manual updates only
options.body: Leave `openclaw skills update --all` and `openclaw plugins update --all` as the supported maintenance path until ClawHub trust and rollback are stronger.

options.title: External scheduler guidance
options.body: Document cron/system scheduler examples around existing commands instead of adding gateway-owned background mutation.

recommendation.title: Design gated auto-update
recommendation.body: Proceed only after maintainers define signing or digest verification, moderation state, pin/deny behavior, rollback, failure reporting, and explicit opt-in semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work ties this account to both ClawHub skill update hardening and plugin update safety paths.
